rows.definition: Vulkan registered shader module for fused interleaved QG attention postprocessing with a separate unchanged gate output.
rows.distinction: Unlike the split-Q qwen35_attention_postprocess shader, consumes doubled interleaved QG and emits an additional unchanged gate. Unlike the fvk QG host boundary, this is the numerical shader and trusted artifact-census identity, not buffer validation or command recording. Unlike attention implementation dispatch, it implements one fused module rather than routing algorithms.
